title: A learning path (path.json), format sigrix-learning-path/1
description: The learning path a pack of lesson bundles carries beside them, which lists the lessons on the learning site in the order they are taken. A reader ignores a member it does not know and refuses a format it does not know. An import adds the path, or updates the one of the same title; that each lesson it lists is in the pack or already on the site is no JSON Schema's to state, and SPEC.md says it.
$comment: A pattern that holds a whole value ends in (?![\s\S]), which is the end of the text in every regular expression engine; $ is not, since in some it also matches before a final line break.

format.description: The format and its major version. A reader refuses a format it does not know.

title.description: The path's title, which is not blank. An import updates the path of the same title, if there is one.

audience.description: Who the path is for, in a few words.

description.description: What the path covers, in a sentence or two.

lessons.description: Each lesson's slug, once, in the order the lessons are taken: at most twelve.
